answer: Every graded answer carries an invisible watermark from its author's key and the epoch seed, woven through word choice like pigment through quartz: one hidden pattern never legitimately appears under two identities. Each epoch a jury scan compares watermarks; any collision seizes the 25.000 POA bond, half burned and half paid to the reporter, plus a 12-epoch ban. Running 1.000 fakes costs 1.000 × 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA, while an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once. Limitation: heavy paraphrasing can blur a watermark, so detection stays probabilistic and needs the soft velvet of human review.
